home.faq1Q: What exactly does an AI automation agency for startups do?
home.faq1A: Maleo AI helps startups and companies implement AI to improve efficiency, automate workflows, and support smarter business decisions. Beyond building software, we identify repetitive processes, operational bottlenecks, and growth opportunities where AI can create real business impact. This can include: AI-powered internal tools, workflow automation, customer support AI agents, business intelligence & reporting systems, custom AI product development, and process optimization using automation. Think of us as a mix of AI strategist, product partner, and execution team.
home.faq2Q: How is Maleo AI different from a typical software development agency?
home.faq2A: We combine strategic thinking, execution, and access to specialized expertise. Maleo AI is backed by a curated network of 100+ senior technology experts across APAC and Europe, allowing us to activate the right specialists in AI, software engineering, cybersecurity, blockchain and emerging technologies based on each project's needs. With us, clients can move faster, access niche expertise on demand, and avoid unnecessary hiring overhead for highly specialized technical work.
home.faq3Q: Do you work with early-stage startups or only established companies?
home.faq3A: Yes. We work with early-stage startups, founders, and growing businesses, especially teams that need technical direction but don't want to waste time or budget building the wrong thing. Whether you're validating an idea, streamlining operations, or preparing to scale, we help turn ideas into practical systems. We're especially useful for founders who need strategic thinking and execution support without building a large internal tech team too early.
home.faq4A: We work across industries where AI and automation can drive meaningful efficiency and smarter decision-making. This includes: professional services, recruitment & HR, education, hospitality & tourism, e-commerce, real estate, financial services, and operations-heavy businesses. That said, we care more about the problem quality than the industry itself. If there's inefficiency, manual work, or decision bottlenecks we'll explore whether AI can help.
home.faq5A: We start with a discovery call to understand your business, goals, bottlenecks, and where AI can realistically create value. From there, we typically go through: 1) Discovery & Assessment - understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities. 2) Strategy & Solution Design - recommend the right AI systems, automation, or product roadmap. 3) Build & Implementation - develop and deploy the solution. 4) Optimization & Support - improve performance and ensure adoption. No unnecessary complexity. Just practical AI implementation designed to make business operations smarter and more efficient.

aiTraining.subtitle: Your team doesn't need to understand algorithms. They need to know how AI solves your business problems.
aiTraining.challengeTitle: Why most Indonesian businesses struggle with AI
aiTraining.challengeIntro: Building AI tools quickly is easy. Making sure those tools are safe, stable, and maintainable by your team, that's the hard part.
aiTraining.challenge1Desc: Most mid-sized Indonesian businesses store data across disconnected systems. Nobody gets the full picture, and AI can't work with scattered inputs.
aiTraining.challenge2Desc: Threats like deepfakes and fake documents are growing, but most teams don't yet have protocols to detect or defend against them.
aiTraining.challenge3Desc: When the one person who understands your AI system leaves, everything can fall apart. That knowledge needs to live in the team, not the individual.
aiTraining.challenge4Desc: AI tools get purchased, then go unused. Money is spent, but value is never realized, because teams weren't trained to use them confidently.
aiTraining.solutionTitle: Three ways we help your team
aiTraining.solutionDesc: We don't teach complex data science. We teach your team how to evaluate, deploy, and optimize AI for real business problems.
aiTraining.workshopSubtitle: Your team learns by doing, working with live AI tools on real scenarios from Indonesian industries, not sitting through algorithm lectures. No coding required.
aiTraining.workshopDesc: Department heads making technology decisions, operations managers who want to automate, finance teams analyzing business data, marketing teams running campaigns at scale.
aiTraining.workshopAudience: Department heads, operations managers, finance and marketing teams implementing AI tools.
aiTraining.workshopDuration: 2–3 days · Onsite & remote · Finance, ops, marketing · No coding required
aiTraining.customDevSubtitle: We build an AI solution tailored to your specific workflows, then train your internal team to manage, update, and improve it independently. You own the system fully when we're done.
aiTraining.supportSubtitle: AI isn't a one-time project. We stay available after launch, document every process, and ensure new team members can learn from your internal experts.
aiTraining.differenceTitle: What makes us different for Indonesian businesses
aiTraining.difference1Desc: Training in Indonesian and English. Examples drawn from local industries. We know how Indonesian businesses actually operate.
aiTraining.difference2Desc: We start with the business outcome you want, then show how AI gets you there. Just enough theory to use tools with confidence.
aiTraining.difference3Desc: When we're done, your team manages the system independently. No ongoing dependency on expensive external consultants.
aiTraining.benefits3MonthsDesc: Team understands AI fundamentals and can evaluate solutions. First AI tools deployed without external help. Manual work in key processes starts to reduce.
aiTraining.benefits6MonthsDesc: Custom AI solutions built and owned by your internal team. Faster processes, fewer errors across departments. Reliance on external consultants decreases.
aiTraining.benefitsBeyondDesc: AI is embedded in how your business operates day-to-day. Your team adapts solutions as the business evolves. A foundation for continued digital transformation.
aiTraining.caseStudy1Desc: Lead Discovery App: automating the sales pipeline. The challenge: Sales teams were spending most of their time on research, hunting for prospects, validating leads, and updating records before any actual selling could happen. What we did: We built a Lead Discovery App that automates prospect identification, data enrichment, segmentation, automated outreach, and CRM synchronization. Then we trained the sales team to use, monitor, and continuously improve the system themselves. Result: Pipeline fills faster. Customer acquisition costs dropped. The team now manages and optimizes the system independently.
aiTraining.caseStudy2Desc: AI for small businesses: tourism, restaurants, retail. The challenge: Small business owners in Bali wanted to use AI but assumed it was only for large tech companies. They didn't know what tools were accessible or affordable for their context. What we did: We ran a hands-on workshop demonstrating practical, affordable AI tools applied to their specific industries: tourism, restaurants, and retail. Result: Participants implemented 8 AI solutions within 30 days. All running independently without ongoing external support.
aiTraining.caseStudy3Desc: From manual AI use to AI-powered operations. The challenge: Most people treat AI as an additional skill, used manually for one-off tasks. The result is limited productivity gains, fragmented workflows, and no long-term scalability. What we did: At BytePlus Startup Connect Bali, Maleo AI introduced a different framing: AI isn't just a tool, it's leverage. We shared how startups can identify the right use cases, implement tailored solutions, and embed them into day-to-day operations as infrastructure, not experimentation. Result: Founders shifted from 'How do I use AI?' to 'How do I build systems powered by AI?', moving from productivity hacks to scalable execution.
aiTraining.faq1Q: Does my team need to know programming?
aiTraining.faq1A: No. We focus on using AI tools and interpreting results, not writing code. If your team can use Excel, they can learn this.
aiTraining.faq2A: It depends on your needs. A foundational workshop runs 2–3 days. Building a custom solution with full team training typically takes 2–4 months.
aiTraining.faq3Q: What if something goes wrong after training?
aiTraining.faq3A: We provide ongoing support. Your team will also be equipped to handle issues themselves and will know when to reach out to us.
aiTraining.faq4A: One automated process typically covers the cost of training within 2–3 months. After that, the savings compound continuously.
aiTraining.faq5Q: Can you train a remote team?
aiTraining.faq5A: Absolutely. We offer flexible onsite and remote delivery. The tools and methods work just as effectively in a remote setting.
aiTraining.faq6Q: What happens when new team members join?
aiTraining.faq6A: We provide comprehensive documentation and train-the-trainer programs so new hires can learn from your internal experts without needing to bring us back in.
